attributes.title: Root trace-group coverage
attributes.description: Compares visible root traces with roots carrying traceGroup. Child spans intentionally do not participate.

attributes.title: Root trace groups — up to 500, application-first
attributes.description: Root-only groups ordered by most recently seen. Page controls cover the returned 500-group boundary.
